subject: 2026-10-07-hsbc-uk-wealth-ai-job-cuts
text:
Brief says: "Financial adviser roles are now set to fall by around 70 per cent, which turns that warning into a concrete plan within months." (note)
Source says: "reductions among financial advisers could reach around 70 per cent, the report said, citing people familiar with the plans." and "HSBC is currently in a consultation period on the proposed changes." (https://www.businesstimes.com.sg/companies-markets/banking-finance/hsbc-plans-job-cuts-across-uk-wealth-business-ai-push-report)
Suggested fix: "Reductions among financial advisers could reach around 70 per cent, according to people familiar with the plans, and HSBC is in a consultation period on the proposed changes." ("Set to fall" and "a concrete plan" are stronger than "could reach" and "proposed".)
